title: Running Commentary on Torah 56 — Yom Ha'Bikurim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 56 — יום הביכורים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **Opening**: **"U'v'yom ha'bikurim b'hakrivchem minchah chadashah la'Hashem, b'Shavuoseichem, mikra kodesh yihyeh lachem, kol melecheis avodah lo sa'asu"** (Bamidbar 28:26).

**"α. In every Jew there is **bechina of malchus**, per his bechina: some rule in their household, some over more, some over the whole world. **'Sarei alafim, sarei me'os, sarei chamishim, sarei asaros'** (Shemos 18:21). This malchus is in **'b'is'galya v'b'is'kasya'** — revealed rule (explicit authority) and concealed (influence/modeling)."**

intermediate.en: **α. Every Jew has bechina of malchus** ("sarei alafim," Shem 18:21) — b'is'galya + b'is'kasya.
intermediate.he: **α. לכל יהודי בחינת מלכות** ("שרי אלפים", שמ' יח, כא) — באתגליא+באתכסיא.

beginner.en: **"β. Must not use malchus **for self**, lest it be like a **slave to his ta'avos**. Rather — **ben chorin**: **'ashrecha aretz she'malkech ben chorin'** (Kohelet 10:17) — the malchus should be **ben chorin for you** (not used for self-benefit)."** **"This is **Mordechai = mar dror** (Chullin 139b): **maras=malchus** has **dror + cheirus** — not self-used, only for Hashem — **'v'haytah la'Hashem ha'melucha'** (Ovadyah 1:21). I.e., use malchus for avodas Hashem — to rebuke + admonish souls under him, per his bechina of rule, whether in household, community, or wider."**

intermediate.en: **β. Malchus as ben chorin** (Koh 10:17), not self-use. Mordechai=**mar dror** (Chul 139b)=cheirus for Hashem ("v'haytah la'Hashem," Ov 1:21). Used for avodah/tochachah.
intermediate.he: **β. מלכות כבן חורין** (קה' י, יז), לא לעצמו. מרדכי=**מר דרור** (חול' קלט:)=חירות לה' ("והייתה לה'", עו' א, כא). לעבודה/תוכחה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. קה' י, יז; חול' קלט:; עו' א, כא.

beginner.en: **"γ. Must draw **arichus yamim** into malchus, lest **'ha'rabbanus m'kaberes es ba'aleha'** (Pesachim 87b). Each Jew is a **tzofeh** per his bechina — must **rebuke + admonish those in his root** — **'tzofeh nesaticha l'beis Yisrael... v'atah ki hizharta rasha'** (Yechezkel 3:17-19) — then he **'saves his own soul.'**"**

intermediate.en: **γ. Draw arichus yamim into malchus** (Pes 87b "rabbanus m'kaberes"). Each=tzofeh → tochachah → saves nefesh (Yech 3:17-19).
intermediate.he: **γ. המשכת אריכות ימים למלכות** (פס' פז: "רבנות מקברת"). כל אחד=צופה → תוכחה → מציל נפשו (יחז' ג, יז-יט).

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. פס' פז:; יחז' ג, יז-יט.

beginner.en: **"**2 hastaros**: even in **hastarah achas** (single concealment) it's hard to find Him, but one can labor and delve until found — since one knows He is hidden. But in **hastarah b'soch hastarah** — the concealment itself is concealed, one doesn't know Hashem is hidden at all — then it's **impossible to find** (since he doesn't know to look)."**

intermediate.en: **2 hastaros**: single=hard but possible; **doubled (hastarah b'soch hastarah)**=impossible — doesn't know He's hidden.
intermediate.he: **ב' הסתרות**: אחת=קשה אך אפשר; **כפולה (הסתרה בתוך הסתרה)**=אי אפשר — לא יודע שמוסתר.

beginner.en: **"But in truth — even in hastarah b'soch hastarah, **certainly Hashem is there, clothed**. Nothing exists without **chiyus Hashem** — without it, it has no kiyum. Therefore in all things, all deeds, all machshavos — Hashem is clothed, k'viyachol. Even when one does an **aveirah** (against His will), certainly there is Hashem's chiyus there, just in **greater concealment** (**hastarah b'soch hastarah**)."**

intermediate.en: Even hastarah kfulah — Hashem clothed (no existence w/o chiyus). In aveirah too — Hashem present in deepest concealment.
intermediate.he: גם הסתרה כפולה — ה' מלובש (אין קיום בלא חיות). גם בעבירה — ה' בהסתרה עמוקה.

beginner.en: **"**'U'v'chol yom va'yom Mordechai mis'haleich li'fnei chatzar beis ha'nashim'** (Esther 2:11). **Mordechai=malchus**; **b'chol yom=Torah** (drawing chiyus into the days/middos). **Chatzar beis=chitzoniyus+p'nimiyus**=machshavos+diburim, in all of which Hashem is **concealed**, even for those **distant from Hashem**. **Beis ha'nashim=lashon of 'nashu v'kaftzu mi'm'komo shel olam'** — those who leaped from the World's Place."**

intermediate.en: Esther 2:11 **"u'v'chol yom Mordechai mis'haleich li'fnei chatzar beis ha'nashim"**: Mordechai=malchus; chatzar=chitzoniyus+p'nimiyus; beis ha'nashim=distance ("nashu v'kaftzu").
intermediate.he: אס' ב, יא **"ובכל יום מרדכי מתהלך לפני חצר בית הנשים"**: מרדכי=מלכות; חצר=חיצוניות+פנימיות; בית הנשים=ריחוק ("נשו וקפצו").

beginner.en: **"δ. Torah clothed in **hastarah b'soch hastarah** = specifically **high Torah = sisrei Torah**. Because she must clothe in such low places (those sunk in aveiros where He is doubly hidden), HKBH planned not to clothe **pshatei ha'Torah** there — lest klipos suckle greatly. Hence specifically **gevohah Torah, sisrei Torah**, which klipos can't grasp, is clothed in those deep hestaros."**

intermediate.en: **δ. Torah in hastarah kfulah=specifically sisrei Torah** (klipos can't reach). Not pshatim (klipos would suckle).
intermediate.he: **δ. תורה בהסתרה כפולה=דווקא סתרי תורה** (קליפות לא משיגות). לא פשטים.

beginner.en: **"ε. Opposite malchus d'kedushah = **malchus ha'rish'ah = Haman-Amalek** (Bamidbar 24:20 **'reishis goyim Amalek'**). Malchus d'kedushah=**'me'aseif l'chol ha'machanos'** (Bamidbar 10:25) = **'sof davar ha'kol nishma, es ha'Elokim yera'** (Kohelet 12:13)=yiras malchus (Avos 3:2 **'ilmalei moraah shel malchus'**). Amalek=opposite = **'reishis' goyim**."**

intermediate.en: **ε. Malchus kedushah vs Amalek-malchus-rish'ah** (Bam 24:20). Kedushah=me'aseif (Bam 10:25; Koh 12:13; Avos 3:2).
intermediate.he: **ε. מלכות קדושה מול עמלק-רשעה** (במ' כד, כ). קדושה=מאסף (במ' י, כה; קה' יב, יג; אבות ג, ב).

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. במ' כד, כ; י, כה; קה' יב, יג.

beginner.en: **"ζ. Per **hagdalas ha'da'as**, parnasah comes easier. Parnasah b'nekel depends on da'as — **'shatu ha'am v'lak'tu'** (Bamidbar 11:8) = **'b'shtusa'** (Zohar Beshalach 62, 63). Who lacks da'as toils+ strains for parnasah. Also per hagdalas ha'da'as, **shalom multiplies** — **'v'gar ze'ev im keves... ki mal'ah ha'aretz dei'ah'** (Yeshayahu 11:6-9) — wondrous shalom when land is full of da'as."**

intermediate.he: **ז. פרנסה בנקל∝דעת** (במ' יא, ח "שטו", זוה"ק בשלח סב-סג "בשטותא"). שלום∝דעת (יש' יא, ו-ט).

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. במ' יא, ח; זוה"ק בשלח סב-סג; יש' יא, ו-ט.

beginner.en: **"η. **Shavuos = sechel gadol + chesed elyon + rachamim gedolim**. Greatness of rachamim depends on greatness of da'as. **'B'sha'as matan Torah, nir'ah lahem k'zakein malei rachamim'** (Mekhilta Beshalach/Yisro; Rashi Yisro). **Zakein=yishuv ha'da'as** (**'ein zakein ela she'kanah chochmah'**). Hence Shavuos=chesed elyon. **Mikveh of Shavuos** = the **mikveh of sha'ar ha'chamishim** (50th gate = Binah)."**

intermediate.en: **ζ. Shavuos=chesed elyon+rachamim** (Mekhilta/Rashi "zakein malei rachamim"=yishuv da'as). **Mikveh Shavuos=sha'ar ha'50=Binah**.
intermediate.he: **ז. שבועות=חסד עליון+רחמים** (מכיל'/רש"י "זקן מלא רחמים"=יישוב הדעת). **מקווה שבועות=שער ה־50=בינה**.

beginner.en: **"η. Chazal (Kiddushin 38a): **'es ha'man achlu 40 shanah — v'halo 40 chaser 30 yom — ela ugah she'hotzi'u mi'Mitzrayim, ta'amu bah ta'am man'**. Truly, **man=da'as**, and 40 = **Binah + Da'as** (as above). I.e., immediately on leaving Mitzrayim, when da'as revealed, they should have received man. Chazal resolve: the **ugah from Mitzrayim had the ta'am of man** — i.e., even before formal man, they tasted da'as via that ugah."**

intermediate.en: **η. Kid 38a**: "40 chaser 30 yom — ugah"; man=da'as; 40=Binah+Da'as; ugah-ta'am-man = early taste of da'as.
intermediate.he: **ז. קיד' לח**: "מ' חסר ל' — עוגה"; מן=דעת; מ'=בינה+דעת; עוגה-טעם-מן = טעימת דעת מוקדמת.

beginner.en: **"θ. To reach **machlokes l'shem shamayim**, must **purify and cleanse the shamayim** so it's not **'alvish shamayim kadrus'** (Yeshayahu 50:3). Purifying shamayim via **anachah b'emes**. The **ru'ach ha'dofek in the lev** (starting from formation) carries all **lachuyos, damim, juices** — moves through all limbs, shaking off rot. **Anachah=drawing pure breath**."**

intermediate.en: **θ. Machlokes l'shem shamayim requires purifying shamayim** ("alvish shamayim kadrus," Yesh 50:3) via **anachah b'emes** (ru'ach ha'dofek in lev drives out rot).
intermediate.he: **ח. מחלוקת לש"ש דורשת זיכוך שמים** ("אלביש שמים קדרות", יש' נ, ג) ע"י **אנחה באמת** (רוח הדופק בלב מסלק רקבון).

beginner.en: **"**Peirush pasuk**: **'U'v'yom ha'bikurim'** = **malchus** (**'af ani b'chor etnehu, elyon l'malchei aretz,'** Tehillim 89:28). **'B'hakrivchem minchah chadashah la'Hashem'** = **Torah chadashah** (Vayikra Rabbah 13:3) = **Toras Hashem** made via bechina of malchus. **'B'Shavuoseichem'**=da'as=man=mikveh of sha'ar ha'50 (as above). Hence Shavuos=**Atzeres**, lashon of malchus (**'ya'atzor ba'am,'** Shmuel I)."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush pasuk**: yom ha'bikurim=malchus (Teh 89:28); minchah chadashah=Torah chadashah (VR 13:3); b'Shavuoseichem=da'as/man/mikveh sha'ar ha'50. Atzeres=malchus.
intermediate.he: **פירוש הפסוק**: יום הביכורים=מלכות (תה' פט, כח); מנחה חדשה=תורה חדשה (ויק"ר יג, ג); בשבועותיכם=דעת/מן/מקווה ה־50. עצרת=מלכות.

scholarly.he: תה' פט, כח; ויק"ר יג, ג.
